summary: RETEST of Head Out (/women/head-out) after the iteration 87 fixes. All 3 open bugs are fixed, all 3 small fixes work, and nothing regressed. Backend: 15/15 pass. /api/geo/autocomplete returns 200 with provider 'osm', with and without lat/lng, on repeated identical calls and on varied queries. Frontend (375x667 Playwright, mocked geolocation, 3s-delayed autocomplete route to force in-flight races): FIX1 PASS: Enter shows dp-suggestions (3 rows), they are still visible 2.5s later, and choosing one updates the field and pin; the Search button works the same way. FIX2 PASS: (a) Clear while a lookup is in flight leaves no dropdown after the late response, and Clear during the debounce wait sends no request; (b) Enter right after typing, and Enter while a lookup is in flight, both keep the typeahead dropdown hidden while the manual results stay visible; (c) deleting 'saket' back to 'sa' closes the dropdown and it stays closed after the late response. FIX3 PASS: dp-save-place is at x=311 with width 44, inside the 375px screen, and there is no horizontal scroll. SMALL FIX A PASS: with location granted and no pin set, the marker, the radius circle and the map centre are all at the user's position (28.5494, 77.2001), not Delhi. This works both after tapping Allow and when an earlier grant resumes on page load. SMALL FIX B PASS: 'Not now' closes dp-location-intro with zero geolocation calls and no change in status; 'Show my position' starts the watch and the button changes to 'Recenter on me'. SMALL FIX C PASS: 3 SPA round trips (home -> head-out -> back) with the live dot showing caused no error boundary and no console or page errors, and watchers stayed balanced (watch 3 / clear 3 / active 0). Regression PASS: typeahead select (pin, circle and map centre move to Connaught Place), 'No places found' for nonsense input, dot and accuracy ring move when the mocked position changes, Recenter after a pan, denied fallback text plus a usable form, radius 100/300/200/Custom 450 (circle radius checked), map tap moves pin and circle, pin dragend handler moves pin and circle (checked via a Maps dragend event; a mouse drag in headless Chrome did not grab the marker, which is a test-harness limit), timer counts down (29:59 -> 29:57), 'I'm home safely' resets the form, and no sms: link appears. Unit suites: destinationMapPicker.logic 42/42, mapValidation 18/18, headOutTimer 35/35, destinationPickerRadius 28/28.

issues: When text is present, dp-destination-input shrinks to about 179px wide because 3 square buttons share the row. The placeholder and longer labels are cut off. This is acceptable, but a full-width input with the buttons on a second row (or inside the field) would read better.

action_items: Optional: src/hooks/useJourneyGPS.ts:161-174. The cleanup at line 173 calls subRef.current?.remove() without a guard, and a watcher that finishes starting after `cancelled` is set is never removed (it leaks on native). This matches the pattern already fixed in useLivePosition. The feature flag is off and the web path returns early, so this is low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: In DestinationPicker.tsx, submitSearch sets suppressBlurHideRef=true unconditionally. With submitBehavior='submit' the input may not blur on Enter, so the flag can stay set. The next real blur (tapping elsewhere) would then skip hiding the dropdown once. This is minor; consider resetting the flag after the search resolves.

In both map pickers, the default pin follows the first live fix only. It does not follow later movement (it moves again only on Recenter). That is reasonable, but note that the pin is visible even though value.latitude/longitude are still null until the user taps or drags.
DestinationPicker.tsx is 1232 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting out the modals (LocationIntroModal, EditPlaceModal, the confirm modal) and the fetch helpers.

seed_data_creation: None. No places were saved (dp-save-place was only measured, never tapped). One Head Out session was started and then ended with 'I'm home safely'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: page.request.post /api/auth/login, then set localStorage gk_token, gk_user (JSON) and gk_consent_version='2026-10-01'. Add /app/tests/i88_init.js with page.add_init_script BEFORE goto: window.__geo counts geolocation calls and watchers, and window.__gmState() returns live Circle/Marker/Map positions. Destination circle fill is #1A3F74; the user dot and ring fill is #1A73E8. __gmState is reliable only on a fresh page load, not after SPA navigation. Use page.route with an async sleep on **/api/geo/autocomplete** to force in-flight races. A mouse drag of the Google marker does not work headless; trigger google.maps.event 'dragend' on the marker instead.
rca_of_issue: All iteration 87 bugs were verified fixed: Enter now keeps results (suppressBlurHideRef plus submitBehavior), stale typeahead responses are dropped (placesReqRef bump and debounce clear on Clear, on fewer than 3 characters and on submit), and the input row overflow is fixed (minWidth 0 / flexShrink 1).
